newsitem.title: USA: Colorado feedlot cattle trade slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado feedlot cattle trade slow - USDA.

text.p: Trading of slaughter cattle very slow Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers not established.
Week to date total includes 9,400 head sold on a contract or formula basis for this week's delivery.
Sales reported on 50 steers and 250 heifers
Slaughter steers: Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 104.00.
Slaughter heifers: Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 104.00.
Confirmed Sales: 300 Last Week: 500 Last Year: 1,500
Week to Date : 29,600 Last Week: 18,000 Last year: 25,500
